svg.title: dfwb-protocols. Versioned splits for public deepfake datasets, CC BY 4.0.
svg.desc: dfwb-protocols: versioned train, validation and test splits for public deepfake datasets, CC BY 4.0. Four stages, each ticking green in turn: dataset lists (identifiers and labels, never media), versioned splits (train, validation and test), scheme hashes (sha256, pinned per version) and the CC BY 4.0 licence.
svg.text: Versioned splits for public deepfake datasets, CC BY 4.0.
